# Security Reports

Report vulnerabilities privately using
[GitHub's vulnerability reporting page](https://github.com/huanli-00/varies-kani/security/advisories/new).
Include the affected commit, reproducer, command, and impact.
Do not publish sensitive details in a public issue.

Issues specific to upstream Kani can also be reported through
[its security policy](https://github.com/model-checking/kani/security/policy).
